title: [CQ-M02] Whole-task usage correlation
description:
Objective: Extend bounded existing usage receipts/reports with revision, packet, source retrieval, planner, runner and delivery correlation.

Deliverable: Whole-task usage correlation. This is task M02 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Verification command (fresh, exit0 required): node --test scripts/tests/usage-receipt.test.mjs scripts/tests/usage-session.test.mjs scripts/tests/usage-report.test.mjs scripts/tests/usage-attribution.test.mjs

Dependency aliases (wired by Moe task ids after import): M01.
definitionOfDone: Existing provider counter semantics and missing-as-unknown behavior remain unchanged.
Aggregation deduplicates retries and includes participating planner/context/repair work.
No prompts, tool arguments, secrets or invented subscription prices are persisted.

implementationPlan.description: Extend the existing receipt/session path, not the launchers. In usage-receipt.mjs extract/export a small allowlist context normalizer reusable by usage-session.mjs and usage-report.mjs, retaining the existing <=16384-char input and bounded identifier validation. Add optional diagnostic fields planRevision (non-negative safe integer), packetId, sourceRetrievalId, plannerInvocationId, runnerId, candidateId and deliveryReceiptId (bounded identifiers), plus workKind from planning/context/implementation/repair/qa. Keep taskId/workerId/attemptId/launchId/role/model/effort/mode behavior and v1 receipts backward-compatible. Normalize missing or invalid additions to null and never persist arbitrary nested metadata. In usage-session.mjs sanitize returned context instead of spreading arbitrary input; retain fresh random launchId, exclusive mode-0600 receipt creation and fail-open generic warnings. Read only the exact .moe/tasks/<taskId>.json and .moe/attempts/<attemptId>.json, with a stricter filename-safe ID guard, bounded input reads, JSON/object/ID/ownership checks and local error handling. Capture task.planRevision only when its id matches and attempt.runnerId only when attempt.id/taskId/workerId all match; missing/invalid canonical values remain null rather than trusting a caller revision/runner override or defaulting legacy revision to 0. Optional packet/retrieval/planner/work-kind references are observations supplied by producers, not an invitation to invent producers or authorities; absent producers stay unknown. Never infer repair from an error outcome or apportion an interactive multi-task provider session. Keep provider normalizeUsage, dedup event/session identity, stdout and exit behavior unchanged. Inline-comment the additive metadata contract and snapshot timing.
implementationPlan.note: usage-receipt.mjs: exported normalizeUsageContext (exact allowlist: existing 8 fields unchanged + planRevision non-negative safe int, packetId/sourceRetrievalId/plannerInvocationId/runnerId/candidateId/deliveryReceiptId bounded identifiers, workKind enum; invalid/absent -> null); readContext keeps the <=16384-char parse and delegates. Exported readMoeRecord(project, kind, id): strict filename-safe id guard /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,127}$/, regular file <=1 MiB, JSON object with record.id===id, any error -> null, no path in output. Receipt version stays 1; normalizeUsage/dedup/stdout/exit untouched. usage-session.mjs: malformed/non-object context still fails open with MOE_USAGE_REPORT_UNAVAILABLE (existing test); output context is the normalized allowlist (no spread) with fresh randomUUID launchId, exclusive 0600 file; planRevision from exact task record only, runnerId only when attempt id/taskId/workerId all match; caller overrides ignored; legacy missing revision null. Launchers untouched. Receipt+session tests 19/19 pass. Mutation check in /tmp scratch copy: 8/8 mutants killed (ownership x2, caller revision trust, loose id guard, size bound, id match, negative revision, raw spread). CRLF preserved.

implementationPlan.description: Extend usage-report.mjs without replacing legacy summary/providers/tasks/unattributed/taskRecord fields. Carry normalized bounded worker/attempt/launch and new correlation values through readReceipts, mergeGroup and aggregate; retain unique correlation tuples (including explicit nulls) so packet/revision/planner/runner associations are not manufactured by independently cross-joining ID lists. Deduplicate token observations using the existing provider session/event rules BEFORE any new grouping; extra metadata or retry launch IDs must not create billable records, and genuinely new repair/context/planner sessions must count. Conflicting task attribution remains unattributed; conflicting correlation observations must remain visibly ambiguous rather than select a latest value or invalidate otherwise valid provider counters. Add wholeTasks grouped solely by non-null taskId across all participating roles/providers, with provider list, existing observed-token/unknown-record accounting, bounded correlation tuples and an explicit observed-log-records-only coverage scope; do not promise whole-task participation completeness or split one cumulative session's tokens between phases/revisions. Add read-only delivery correlation to these whole-task rows by joining existing .moe/candidates/<id>.json taskId+attemptId to observed attempts and .moe/receipts/<id>.json candidateId; include only allowlisted candidate/attempt/receipt IDs and landedRevision with evidence:'record-only'. Missing, malformed, conflicting or mismatched joins produce unknown/incomplete metadata and bounded generic warnings, never inferred delivery success from DONE/commits. Do not copy target paths, pushResult, prompts, tool arguments, source text or prices. Expose whole-task totals and unknown/correlation limitations in formatUsageReport while retaining the existing record-only, unconfirmed-Codex-stream and no-subscription-cost disclaimers. Document this consumer contract in inline comments; the epic-final task owns the docs sweep.
implementationPlan.note: usage-report.mjs (now exactly 300 lines, CRLF kept): readReceipts attaches one normalized correlation tuple per receipt (role/worker/attempt/runner/planRevision/workKind/packet/retrieval/planner/candidate/deliveryReceipt; explicit nulls) via the shared normalizeUsageContext; mergeGroup keeps unique tuples after the unchanged session/event dedup and counts summary.ambiguousCorrelationGroups without touching counters or conflictingGroups. New wholeTasks[] (grouped only by non-null taskId across roles/providers): providers, existing aggregate() accounting, coverageScope 'observed-log-records-only', correlation {tuples<=32, omittedTuples, ambiguousRecords, unknownRecords per field}, taskRecord, delivery {evidence:'record-only', status recorded|not-recorded|incomplete|unknown, candidates<=32 of candidateId/attemptId/deliveryReceiptId/landedRevision, omittedCandidates}. Delivery joins .moe/candidates via observed attemptId + matching taskId and .moe/receipts by candidateId through readMoeRecord (id==filename, bounded); malformed/unreadable/wrong-task/two-receipts/unconfirmed claimed ids -> incomplete + one generic warning; no attempt -> unknown; DONE/commits never consulted. No target/pushResult/baseRevision/treeSha/paths copied. Legacy summary/providers/tasks/unattributed unchanged (summary gains one stat). Text adds per-task whole-task + correlation lines and an observed-records-only limitation line; existing disclaimers retained. Gate run: 44/44 pass. Read-only smoke run of analyze-usage on this repo: 8 whole-task rows, sane output.

implementationPlan.note: Adversarial self-review of the five-file diff. FIXED: a receipt with landedRevision as an array (e.g. ["aaaa…40 hex"]) passed the hex RegExp through string coercion and was emitted as a 'recorded' delivery; now a string is required (RED->GREEN test). Two report mutants (accept duplicate receipts, ignore a malformed candidate) survived because the combined malformed fixture masked them, so I added an isolated per-defect case table; 10/10 report mutants and 8/8 receipt/session mutants are killed. Checked with no change needed: concurrent and repeated launches (randomUUID plus an exclusive 'wx' 0600 file each); retry and resumed-session metadata variants (tuples kept, counters never split, ambiguity counted separately from conflictingGroups); a multi-task session stays unattributed; null, negative, huge, -0 and __proto__ inputs go through the allowlist only; traversal, device names and FIFOs are refused by the id guard plus stat isFile before read; wrong-task and wrong-attempt joins are incomplete. No prompts, tool arguments, targets, pushResult or prices are stored. Every bundle list (JetBrains, VS Code, local-runner, onboarding) already ships usage-receipt.mjs and prompt-cache-usage.mjs with usage-session.mjs. Theoretical only: a stat/read TOCTOU in readMoeRecord (the daemon writes atomically by rename; worst case is a bigger read), and the per-task candidate scan is O(tasks x candidates). No .moe writes, no Git writes, no second revision authority, no deliveryPolicy/readiness/verified-local change. The architect wrapper's checkpoint 1bb42e1 already holds four of these files; usage-report.mjs and the last test are still uncommitted. Fresh gate after the fixes: exit 0, 45/45, also 45/45 in a clean snapshot of HEAD plus these five files.

completionSummary: CQ-M02 whole-task usage correlation, five files, launchers untouched. usage-receipt.mjs exports normalizeUsageContext: the one allowlist (8 legacy fields unchanged plus planRevision, packet, retrieval, planner, runner, candidate and deliveryReceipt ids, and a workKind enum; absent or invalid -> null, never 0). It also exports readMoeRecord: a filename-safe id guard, a 1 MiB regular-file limit, and a check that the record's own id matches. Receipts stay v1. usage-session.mjs no longer spreads raw input. It snapshots planRevision from the exact task record and runnerId only from an attempt whose id, taskId and workerId all match; caller overrides are ignored. usage-report.mjs keeps every legacy view. It carries correlation tuples through the existing session/event dedup, adds summary.ambiguousCorrelationGroups, and adds wholeTasks[]: totals across roles and providers, bounded tuples with ambiguity and unknown counts, and observed-records-only coverage. Delivery joins candidates and receipts through observed attempts only and is reported record-only (recorded / not-recorded / incomplete / unknown); DONE status and commits are never read as delivery. Targets, pushResult, prompts and prices are never copied. TDD: RED first, then GREEN. Mutation checks killed 18/18 guard mutants. Self-review fixed a RegExp coercion bug (an array landedRevision was being accepted). Gate: 45/45, exit 0, Linux WSL with the python3 engine only; the PowerShell runs were not exercised. Also 45/45 on a clean snapshot of HEAD plus these five files. Note: architect wrapper checkpoint 1bb42e1 already holds four of the files. Workspace CRLF bytes are kept (inherited churn). Packet, retrieval and planner producers do not exist yet; those fields stay unknown.
